section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the two reasons why Yaakov's work in Lavan's house was necessary before he could refine Esav.
section.t: Now, the reason that in order to refine Esav, his work in the house of Lavan had to come first,
is explained in several discourses,
and at length in the discourse beginning "Vayishlach" in the continuation of the year 5672,
[concerning] two matters in this.
The first,
that in order to refine Esav, a most exalted light was needed,
and therefore his work in the house of Lavan had to come first,
[which is] the aspect of the supernal whiteness that is above the chain of descent.
And after, through his work in the house of Lavan over the course of twenty years, he drew down all the lights of the aspect of the supernal whiteness,
even to the matter of "And he [Lavan] arose early in the morning and kissed his sons and his daughters etc.",
the drawing down of the supernal whiteness in the aspect of kisses and the adhesion of spirit to spirit to all the matters of Yaakov,
(to the influencers and the recipients,
his sons and his daughters),
he was able to refine Esav.
And the second,
that the need for the preparatory work in the house of Lavan in order to refine Esav is
(not only from the side of the root of Lavan,
the supernal whiteness,
but also)
from the side of the lower Lavan,
Lavan of the kelipah.
For Esav is lower than Lavan,
for Lavan is [the sefiros of] Chochmah, Binah, and Daas of the side of impurity, and Esav is [the sefiros of] Zeir Anpin and Malchus of the side of impurity,
and therefore one must first refine Lavan,
and afterwards go to refine Esav.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that Yaakov's refinements were from above downward, unlike the current order of refinement which is from below upward.
section.t: Now, the matter is,
that the refinements of Yaakov were, in general, in a manner of from above downward,
by means of the revelation of a supernal light.
For Yaakov is Torah,
[as is known,
that the three Patriarchs are the three lines: Torah, service, and acts of kindness,
Avraham—acts of kindness,
Yitzchak—service,
and Yaakov—Torah],
and the refinement that is through Torah is in a manner of from above downward,
as explained in the discourse beginning "Padeh BeShalom"
regarding the distinction between the refinement of prayer and the refinement of Torah,
that the refinement of prayer is in a manner of from below upward
(it engages with the thing being refined),
and the refinement of Torah is in a manner of from above downward.
For the distinction between these two matters is not only in the manner of refinement,
but also in the order of refinement.
For in the refinement that is in the manner of from below upward
(it engages with the thing being refined),
the order of refinement is also from below upward,
that first one refines the lower and afterwards the upper,
and the refinement in the manner of from above downward
(by means of the revelation of light from above)
is in an order of from above downward.
Therefore,
in the refinements now,
which are
(primarily)
in a manner of from below upward,
the order is that the refinement of the seven lower [sefiros] precedes the refinement of the three upper [sefiros],
and this is why at first there was the conquest of the land of the seven nations and afterwards
(in the future)
will be the conquest of the Keni, Kenizi, and Kadmoni,
and known is the explanation of the Baal HaGeulah of Yud Tes Kislev
[that the ascent of Yud Tes Kislev is on the Shabbos that follows it]
that in the conquest of Yehoshua only the seven [lower] sefiros were refined
(and the intellectual faculties that relate to the [lower] sefiros),
and the three upper [sefiros] will be refined in the future,
but not so in the refinements of Yaakov,
which were in a manner of from above downward,
the order was that first he refined [the sefiros of] Chochmah, Binah, and Daas
(Lavan)
and afterwards [the sefiros of] Zeir Anpin and Malchus
(Esav).

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the advantage of refinement from below upward over refinement from above downward, and how Yaakov's refinement empowered the later refinement.
section.t: Now, it is known,
that although in general the refinement in a manner of from above downward is more exalted than the refinement in a manner of from below upward,
there is an advantage in the refinement in a manner of from below upward over the refinement in a manner of from above downward,
for the refinement in a manner of from above downward,
since the refinement is from the side of the revelation of light
(and not from the side of the lower entity itself),
it does not relate so much to the lower entity itself,
but not so in the refinement in a manner of from below upward,
the lower entity itself becomes a vessel for Elokus.
And this is why even after Yaakov effected the refinement of Esav,
even to the point of "And Esav ran toward him and embraced him etc. and kissed him",
he [Yaakov] said to him,
"I will proceed slowly etc. until I come to my lord, to Seir",
and when will he go? In the days of Moshiach,
as it is stated,
"And saviors shall ascend Mount Zion to judge the mountain of Esav",
for the refinement of Esav that was done by Yaakov was through the revelation of light from above
(as above),
and therefore the refinement was not complete,
and the completion of his refinement in the days of Moshiach is through our deeds and service during the time of exile,
[which is] refinement in a manner of from below upward.
And it can be said,
that this, that his refinement first came about through Yaakov in a manner of from above downward, is a giving of power so that afterwards the refinement in a manner of from below upward could be.
